entries.title_en: TurboGrafx-16 released in Japan as the PC-Engine
entries.title_fr: Sortie de la PC-Engine (future TurboGrafx-16) au Japon
entries.text_en: NEC launched the 16-bit beast that would battle Nintendo and Sega in the console wars—though it never quite won the throne.
entries.text_fr: NEC lançait la PC-Engine, une console 16 bits qui défia Nintendo et Sega… sans jamais vraiment régner.
